---
title: "Motivating Mathematics through Applications (MMA)"
description: "MMA is a repository of motivations for various mathematical topics through realistic examples in a variety of application areas. It is designed primarily for math instructors to learn how the math they teach applies to various fields and for easy plug-and-play distribution to students."
toc: false
---


This website houses a growing assortment of lessons, worksheets, homework
problems, and more for realistic connections between math and the myriad of ways
math can be used in Science, Technology, Engineering, Sociology, Art, and more.
Each application area has background reading targeted for math instructors to be
able to quickly learn some background in the given application area. 

* [Browse by application area](applications/index.qmd).
* [Browse by math topic](math_topics/index.qmd).
